changelog:
- Major simplification: transitioned from a multi-script tool to a single agent-based workflow.
- Removed all standalone repurposing and setup scripts; now handles everything via commands to the agent.
- Platform coverage expanded to include YouTube Shorts/Reels scripts and SEO blog posts.
- Now supports auto-transcription (via Supadata API) and article extraction for URLs.
- Added "Take The Wheel" mode for guided, step-by-step content creation.
- Clear setup instructions and requirements for API usage.
- Pricing section included for agency/service use cases.
summary: Convert any content URL or text into tailored formats for Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, newsletters, YouTube Shorts, and SEO blog posts in one command.
